from: July book, night 10 (The Oil Kept Pouring)
p1: A mother came to Elisha, who spoke for Heavenly Father. Her husband had died, and she owed money. A man was coming to take her two sons away to work.
Elisha asked, “What do you have in your house?” She said, “Only one pot of oil.”
Elisha said, “Borrow empty jars from all your neighbors. Not just a few! Then shut the door and pour.”
p2: She borrowed many jars. Her sons brought them, and she poured and poured. Every jar filled up! When there were no more jars, the oil stopped. Elisha said, “Sell the oil and pay what you owe.” Her family could stay together.
Heavenly Father knows what your family needs. Tonight, hug someone you love. He takes care of all of you.
old: A kind woman was very sad. Her husband had died, and she owed money she could not pay. All she had left was one little pot of oil. She came to the prophet Elisha for help.
Elisha said, “Go borrow lots of empty jars from your neighbors. Get as many as you can!” So she and her sons gathered jars and jars and jars. Then they shut the door.
She started pouring her little bit of oil. But it kept pouring and pouring! It filled every single jar, right to the top. The oil only stopped when there were no more jars left.
Elisha said, “Now sell the oil and pay what you owe.” Heavenly Father gave her more than enough. When we trust God and obey His prophet, He provides. He cares about our family’s needs.
